title: 套娃：本地测尺寸排序—动态规划空行—逐个直立放置
phases: Random layout: identify task targets by semantic shape/texture, exclude distractors, and use the SAME local operation baseline as the ordinary task. Never infer ordinary/random from visual absence of distractors.
Identify all five dolls (not distractors); choose a visibly empty reachable row with table-plane row_start/row_end in world left-to-right direction.
Call sort_row with all five current coarse boxes. Local RGB tools measure heights and footprints, rank size, and allocate measured nonoverlapping row slots.
Move one doll per complete local operation; use a stable body grasp and upright placement. Refresh all relevant identities after motion, preserving stable semantic names.
Inspect tipping and spacing; if a doll fell, pick/reseat instead of counting commanded transfers.
Confirm the five dolls form an upright small-to-large row and home.
failure_lesson: Successful reference runs also used explicit pixel geometry when silhouettes failed. Tipped dolls distinguished many failures despite completed transfer routes.
reference_success_scope: External reports and cached notes include complete successes; new local pipeline not yet tested natively.
